name: PN7150 NFC
description: The `pn7150` component allows you to use PN7150 NFC controllers with ESPHome. This component is a global hub that establishes a connection to the PN7150 via [I²C](https://esphome.io/components/i2c).

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the [I²C Component](https://esphome.io/components/i2c) if you need to use multiple I²C buses.

config_entries.label: IRQ Pin
config_entries.description: The pin connected to the PN7150's `IRQ` line.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Input
config_entries.description: Set the input mode flag.

config_entries.label: Output
config_entries.description: Set the output mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pullup
config_entries.description: Set the pullup mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pulldown
config_entries.description: Set the pulldown mode flag.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: Ven Pin
config_entries.description: The pin connected to the PN7150's `VEN` line.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Input
config_entries.description: Set the input mode flag.

config_entries.label: Output
config_entries.description: Set the output mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pullup
config_entries.description: Set the pullup mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pulldown
config_entries.description: Set the pulldown mode flag.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID for this component.

config_entries.label: Emulation Message
config_entries.description: When scanned by another NFC card/tag reader (such as a smartphone), this string is used as the content for an NDEF-formatted response. This allows the PN7150 to act as a tag in addition to a tag reader/writer.

config_entries.label: Tag Ttl
config_entries.description: The duration that must elapse after the PN7150 is no longer able to "see" a tag before it is considered to have been removed from the reader.
